title: RefSeq gene model track pack (hg38+hg19)
context: RefSeq (NCBI) provides curated gene model annotations as US-government public-domain data with no redistribution restrictions. Many cancer databases and publications use RefSeq accessions (NM_/NP_) to identify transcripts, so a RefSeq track is a useful complement to GENCODE for researchers who need to cross-reference RefSeq-based variant annotations with genomic coordinates. The US-gov public-domain status makes this a clear Priority-A source.
objective: Build a RefSeq gene model track pack on hg38 (primary) and hg19 (secondary), passing the licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 gates, and emitting all three browser targets with per-feature provenance to RefSeq accessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is RefSeq (NCBI, US-gov public domain); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38 and hg19; coordinate convention handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; RefSeq gene features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-refseq-002.json.
Per-feature provenance records RefSeq accession IDs, source release version, and public-domain license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
output: output/packs/refseq-genes-hg38/ and output/packs/refseq-genes-hg19/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-refseq-002.json.
